metodo.titulo: I build with AI. I direct, design and verify.
metodo.sub: Generation is cheap. What I add is agency, judgment and orchestration.
metodo.agencia.texto: I decide what gets built and what doesn't. I write the brief, the flow and the quality bar before asking for a single line.
metodo.agencia.ejemplo: Fortal: the training rules (double progression, volume by available time, weights you can actually load) were written before the first screen.
metodo.juicio.texto: I review every delivery: I accept it, fix it or have it redone with the reason. I choose between alternatives and document it.
metodo.juicio.ejemplo: coro: I rejected ranking complaints by count and chose to measure concentration; twenty topics with five complaints aren't a defect, one with 47% is.
metodo.orquestacion.texto: I chain agents, tests and full-resolution screenshots. Nothing is done until I've seen it rendered.
metodo.orquestacion.ejemplo: Fortal: 391 + 85 unit tests and 237 + 33 end-to-end; every phase verified with 1206×2622 screenshots, one by one.
metodo.confio.titulo: When I trust it and when I redo it
metodo.confio.texto: I trust it when the test passes and the screenshot matches the brief. I redo it when I can't explain the result: if I can't explain it, it doesn't ship. Every case shows one example of each.

caso.cathedra.descripcion: Cathedra, a Windows study app: how I defined it, directed it with AI agents and verified it. Own product in beta.
caso.cathedra.cabecera.alt: Cathedra: a class with its five steps (guide, questions, cards, mock exam, review) on a glass panel over the desk
caso.cathedra.problema: A university student piles up hours of recorded lectures and course material, and does not know what the exam covers or where each explanation is. Rewatching the whole class does not scale; searching the recording by hand does not either.
caso.cathedra.rol.texto: I defined the product, the identity (leather, ivory, crystal, cherry), the six-step flow and the quality bar. I directed the AI-assisted development; I reviewed every batch with full-resolution screenshots and tests; I published the page and the installer.
caso.cathedra.proceso.1: Before asking for a single line I wrote the six steps (start, upload, it reads, ask, sit the exam, review) and the rule that governs them: nothing that is not in the material.
caso.cathedra.proceso.2: Each feature went to an agent with a brief, acceptance criteria and mandatory screenshots. Whatever did not match the brief was redone, with the reason.
caso.cathedra.proceso.3: The emblem and the page scenes come from my own render; they were iterated until the leather and the crystal read as real materials.
caso.cathedra.proceso.4: Public page with the full flow and two Windows installers, full and light, verified on a clean install.
caso.cathedra.decision.1.elegi: Every answer carries the class, the minute and who said it, and the seal stays empty if it is not in the material.
caso.cathedra.decision.1.descarte: Always answering with a fluent text.
caso.cathedra.decision.1.porque: A student needs to know whether they are studying what the lecturer said or an invention.
caso.cathedra.decision.2.elegi: Transcribe and store on the computer, with an offline option.
caso.cathedra.decision.2.descarte: Uploading the lectures to a service.
caso.cathedra.decision.2.porque: The lectures belong to the student and must work without internet and without a quota.
caso.cathedra.resultado: Beta 1.2.0 published: installer for 64-bit Windows 10/11 and a page with the full flow.
caso.cathedra.apoyo: In active development. No users or metrics to report yet.
caso.cathedra.sigue: "Record live" is listed as "soon" and is not there yet: it is the next step. Then, the beta with the first users.

caso.fortal.descripcion: Fortal, an iPhone web app that builds your routine from your real gear and time on a 3D body. Personal app, published and in use.
caso.fortal.enlace: No public link: single-user app, shown with screenshots
caso.fortal.cabecera.alt: Fortal ‘Today’ screen: body hologram with the day's muscles, what is due and the Train button
caso.fortal.problema: Gym apps do not know what gear you have at home or how much real time you have per day. The routine ends up in phone notes and the weights are guessed.
caso.fortal.rol.texto: I defined the concept, the look (layered blacks, blue hologram), the sections and the training rules: double progression, safety without safety bars, volume by available time. I directed the AI-assisted development in phases and reviewed every 1206×2622 screenshot, one by one. I use it daily.
caso.fortal.proceso.1: The training and nutrition rules were written before the first screen; every phase was measured against them.
caso.fortal.proceso.2: A model with twenty muscle regions went through my own pipeline down to a light GLB; each region is painted by what is due today and how it recovers.
caso.fortal.proceso.3: Gym, routine, live session, food: each phase delivered with 1206×2622 screenshots that I reviewed one by one against the brief.
caso.fortal.proceso.4: Local-first, offline web app with automated tests: 391 + 85 unit and 237 + 33 end-to-end.
caso.fortal.decision.1.elegi: Compute the weights you can actually load: plates per side, dumbbell dial, weight stack.
caso.fortal.decision.1.descarte: Asking for the weight by hand.
caso.fortal.decision.1.porque: A suggestion you cannot load in the gym is noise.
caso.fortal.decision.2.elegi: Web app installable from Safari, local first and offline.
caso.fortal.decision.2.porque: The only user was me and I needed to iterate daily with no review and no mandatory server.
caso.fortal.resultado: Published and installed on my iPhone; I use it every day.
caso.fortal.apoyo: No other users and not in the stores: it is a personal app.
caso.fortal.sigue: Opening it to more users would require accounts and onboarding; that is not the goal today.

caso.athleteiq.descripcion: AthleteIQ, a performance-intelligence demo for rugby league staff: landing page with a 3D ball and chat bots. Working demo.
caso.athleteiq.rol: Founder: concept, copy in five languages, design direction, bots and landing page
caso.athleteiq.cabecera.alt: AthleteIQ landing page: headline, 3D rugby ball surrounded by metrics in hexagons
caso.athleteiq.problema: A club's technical staff has the data scattered: injury history, training load, session quality, psychological state. They cannot query it in seconds from the field, which is where decisions are made.
caso.athleteiq.rol.texto: I defined the concept and the value proposition, wrote the copy in five languages and directed the design: dark landing page, 3D ball, metric hexagons. The bots and the landing page were built with AI-assisted development under that direction.
caso.athleteiq.proceso.1: First the message ("The Data Has No Favourites") and the questions the staff would actually ask; then the screens.
caso.athleteiq.proceso.2: Dark, with the 3D ball and the metrics in hexagons; five languages via dictionary (EN, ES, PT, FR, ZH).
caso.athleteiq.proceso.3: They answer by text, voice and photo, in the user's language, about injury risk, load, recovery and squad talent.
caso.athleteiq.proceso.4: Simulated chat on the landing page and test bots with a generic club and fictional players.
caso.athleteiq.decision.1.elegi: Chat bots that answer in natural language.
caso.athleteiq.decision.1.porque: The staff asks from the field on their phone and does not open a dashboard.
caso.athleteiq.decision.2.elegi: Present the demo with a generic club and fictional players.
caso.athleteiq.decision.2.descarte: Publishing the version tied to a real club.
caso.athleteiq.decision.2.porque: Without a contract you do not display someone else's name or assumed figures as results.
caso.athleteiq.resultado: Landing page and bots working as a demo.
caso.athleteiq.apoyo: No clients or contracts. No ROI or player figures: they were demo assumptions and are not published.
caso.athleteiq.sigue: Validate with a club. Today it is a prototype of a proposal, not a product.

caso.coro.descripcion: coro reads a product's reviews, finds the recurring defect and who already fixed it. Command-line prototype with an HTML report.
caso.coro.rol: Defined the product, the metric and the report; directed development
caso.coro.cabecera.alt: coro report: header, verdict and four metrics of the test product
caso.coro.problema: A thousand negative reviews spread over twenty topics are noise; a hundred saying the same thing is a fixable defect. Whoever buys, sells or manufactures has no time to read them and does not know whether someone already solved it.
caso.coro.rol.texto: I defined the four reading profiles, the metric that decides, the rule about solutions and the report format. I directed the AI-assisted development and validated it with my own fixture.
caso.coro.proceso.1: Consumer, entrepreneur, brand that buys from a third party and brand that manufactures: each reads the same report with a different question.
caso.coro.proceso.2: Share of negative reviews that mention the topic, by severity, with a surcharge if it grows over time.
caso.coro.proceso.3: They are searched for and cited with a source; if there is no evidence, the report says so.
caso.coro.proceso.4: HTML with verdict, topics by priority, quotes, root-cause hypothesis and estimated impact; validated with my own fixture of 32 reviews of a filtered shower head.
caso.coro.decision.1.elegi: Measure concentration (share pointing at the same thing), not the number of complaints.
caso.coro.decision.1.porque: Twenty topics with five complaints are not a defect; one with 47 % is.
caso.coro.decision.2.elegi: Solutions are searched for and cited with a source, and the report says when there is no evidence.
caso.coro.decision.2.porque: An invented solution is worth less than a "not found".
caso.coro.resultado: Command-line prototype that generates the HTML report on a product or a local fixture.
caso.coro.sigue: Publish a sanitised sample report as a page; today there are only screenshots.
caso.coro.siguiente.alt: Porcelain frame with a screenshot of Cathedra
caso.coro.galeria.aviso: Screenshots of the test fixture; suppliers and sources replaced with generic names.
